steps.en: Officer clicks Cancel on the saved-address confirmation screen
steps.id: Officer menekan Cancel di layar konfirmasi alamat
steps.why_en: It is a generic update dialog, not a Letter of Advice confirmation screen.
steps.why_id: Ini dialog update umum, bukan layar konfirmasi Letter of Advice.

steps.en: The decision to proceed with the Letter of Advice is cancelled
steps.id: Keputusan lanjut Letter of Advice dibatalkan
steps.why_en: No proceed decision exists in the system to cancel.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada keputusan lanjut di sistem untuk dibatalkan.

steps.en: OCMS returns to the previous screen so the officer can edit the address or change the decision to reject
steps.id: OCMS kembali ke layar sebelumnya untuk edit alamat/ubah keputusan
steps.why_en: Address editing stays open, but the option to switch to reject is missing.
steps.why_id: Edit alamat tetap terbuka, tapi pilihan beralih ke tolak tidak ada.
